key_provisions_or_claims: Specifies requirements for developing and maintaining operational safety cases for automated vehicle tests and trials in the UK
Risks must be reduced as low as reasonably practicable (ALARP) with no unreasonable risks
Applies where a safety driver/operator in the vehicle can intervene immediately
Requires safety management systems, route assessments, and incident/near-miss response prioritization
Adds requirements on override controls for the ADS, modifications to base vehicles, safety case review/approval, and insurance
annotation.summary_en: BSI catalogue page for PAS 1881:2026, a UK specification for assuring operational safety of automated vehicle tests and trials with an in-vehicle safety driver. It sets requirements for operational safety cases, safety management systems, ADS overrides and insurance, aiming for ALARP risk. It is a full revision of the earlier PAS.
